text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Mm. I shall permit your felicitations. 
Celebrate to your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Actually, I've 
prepared a present for ya as well.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Yes. They're traditional Kansai steamed 
buns. I once offered some to Orfe-san 
before, but...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
There's a whole box this time. They keep 
for a while, so please feel free to have 
some whenever you fancy.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —Shall we take a tea break soon?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll get that ready for you. What 
would you like for a tea treat? If you'd 
like, maybe one of the gift manju...—
